posts.title: Four Claude models matched the answer key on 100 AI law questions 95.8% of the time from memory and 99.9% with the rule text
posts.description: I asked four Claude models 100 questions on California's SB 53, New York's RAISE Act, the EU AI Act and US chip rules. From memory, 95.8% of their replies matched the answer key. With the rule text in the prompt, 99.9% did, and with web search, 97.7% did on the 82 questions that version finished. Seven questions account for 39 of the 51 misses from memory.

posts.title: AIs predict that DC banning foie gras would increase the chances of future animal welfare regulations
posts.description: Before DC's November 3 vote, eight AI forecasters, each researching alone, give Initiative 86 an 89.7% chance of passing. After a one-point loss, they give 22% to someone filing a new DC initiative on farmed animals or animal products by the end of 2028; after a one-point win, 31%.

posts.title: Testing California's bond funds against the billionaire tax odds
posts.description: Prediction markets have priced California's Proposition 40 for almost a year, and a fund of California municipal bonds has not moved with the odds by any amount I could detect. Before November 3, I registered a test that pools ballot measures across states.
